scope: Research references, not installed-model inventory, license clearance, audited code or a leaderboard. No model inference performed in this pass.

entries.title: ComfyUI official workflow templates
entries.opportunity: Start every family from its native graph; inspect related templates before inventing nodes.
entries.caveat: Pin core, frontend and template revisions; a current template may not fit the installed backend.

entries.title: ComfyUI App Mode
entries.opportunity: Expose selected inputs and outputs without duplicating a node editor.
entries.caveat: Check installed frontend version; keep Studio focused on projects, experiments and lineage.

entries.title: Subgraphs and reusable stages
entries.opportunity: Package conditioning, repair and export stages as reusable graph modules.
entries.caveat: A convenient graph boundary is not automatically a durable cache or worker boundary.

entries.title: Partial execution
entries.opportunity: Iterate only the selected downstream portion during tuning.
entries.caveat: Does not replace persistent run records or guarantee cross-process cache reuse.

entries.title: Animagine XL 4.0
entries.opportunity: Controlled anime and manga illustration baseline alongside existing WAI presets.
entries.caveat: Keep its conditioning conventions and compatible adapters; verify exact installed checkpoint.

entries.title: Illustrious XL v2.0
entries.opportunity: Compare an upstream anime family against the installed WAI derivative.
entries.caveat: Not an automatic upgrade; checkpoint lineage and adapter compatibility matter.

entries.title: RealVisXL V5.0
entries.opportunity: Keep a smaller specialist for realistic art and product-concept comparisons.
entries.caveat: Invented product details remain invented; use source photography or geometry for exact products.

entries.title: FLUX.2 klein 4B
entries.opportunity: Fast iteration and reference editing lane; compare against the installed Klein variant.
entries.caveat: Do not apply FLUX.1 adapters or assume all FLUX.2 sizes have identical terms.

entries.title: Z-Image base
entries.opportunity: Compare base-model flexibility against the already used Turbo path.
entries.caveat: Base and Turbo recipes are distinct; do not reuse distilled schedules blindly.

entries.title: Qwen-Image-2512
entries.opportunity: Alternative for instruction-rich illustrations, layouts and image comparisons.
entries.caveat: Budget encoder, offload and RAM separately; not locally tested in this pass.

entries.title: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511
entries.opportunity: Reference-conditioned edits, compared against the existing Qwen setup.
entries.caveat: Preserve exact source pixels outside an approved edit mask by compositing.

entries.title: HiDream-O1 Image
entries.opportunity: Extend the repo-recorded isolated FP8 feasibility result into controlled quality tests.
entries.caveat: Existing evidence covers one corrected text-only run, not all resolutions or reference edits.

entries.title: Ideogram 4
entries.opportunity: Typography-oriented candidate to compare when a concrete brief justifies it.
entries.caveat: Review gated weights, separate terms, runtime requirements and default hosted dependencies.

entries.title: Pixel Art XL LoRA
entries.opportunity: SDXL pixel-style concept adapter; useful before deliberate pixel-scale finishing.
entries.caveat: Not native pixel-perfect output. Family SDXL; review both adapter and base terms.

entries.title: FLUX Watercolor Strokes LoRA
entries.opportunity: Small style experiment for fantasy illustrations; author trigger WTRCLR, watercolor.
entries.caveat: FLUX.1-dev adapter, not FLUX.2 Klein. No quality or training-data rights audit here.

entries.title: Xinsir Union SDXL / ProMax
entries.opportunity: Combine pose, depth or line guidance; evaluate ProMax editing features separately.
entries.caveat: The repo reports an installed Union download. Match exact standard/ProMax weights and node mode.

entries.title: IPAdapter Plus
entries.opportunity: Reference appearance and composition alongside pose/depth controls.
entries.caveat: Pin matching image encoder, adapter and base; conditioning is not identity proof.

entries.title: ControlNet auxiliary preprocessors
entries.opportunity: Pose, depth and line-art preparation for repeatable guidance assets.
entries.caveat: Preprocessors create hints; they are not the corresponding ControlNet weights.

entries.title: Krita AI Diffusion
entries.opportunity: Use an actual painting canvas for masks, layers and iterative image finishing.
entries.caveat: Validate the installed plugin/backend pair; retain editable source layers.

entries.title: Ultimate SD Upscale
entries.opportunity: Compare tiled diffusion redraw against the installed non-generative anime upscaler.
entries.caveat: Redraw may change identity, linework and small details; use an untouched reference crop.

entries.title: MiniMax H3 native workflows
entries.opportunity: First/last frames, multimodal references, audio and control-video workflows.
entries.caveat: Local commercial output use has a separate license requirement; AMD feasibility remains unmeasured.

entries.title: MiniMax H3 Comfy model pack
entries.opportunity: Resolve the downloaded FL2VA diffusion model with the matching encoder and both VAEs.
entries.caveat: INT8-convrot recommendation mentions cu130. A known folder does not prove Radeon loader support.

entries.title: MiniMax H3 Turbo
entries.opportunity: Use matching four/eight-step adapters as a bounded preview branch.
entries.caveat: Keep FL2V/REF2V adapter, schedule and model variant aligned; preview winners need final re-review.

entries.title: MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet Union
entries.opportunity: Drive generated shots with authored motion, depth, pose and masks.
entries.caveat: Additional model and control preparation cost; verify backend-specific node support.

entries.title: H3 learned latent upscaler
entries.opportunity: Learned spatial latent enlargement before H3 refinement; inspect 2D/3D and tiled variants.
entries.caveat: Author distinguishes speed savings from VRAM savings. Temporal seams and final refinement need tests.

entries.title: FL MiniMaxH3 timeline tools
entries.opportunity: Prompt timelines, temporal reshots, beat planning and shot assembly.
entries.caveat: Preserve nested audio/video latents and rebuild size-dependent conditioning after spatial changes.

entries.title: MiniMax H3 caching experiments
entries.opportunity: Separate expensive conditioning from sampling and decoding for seed sweeps.
entries.caveat: Audit serialization: never load an untrusted pickle or torch.save cache; preserve complete conditioning.

entries.title: LTX-2.5
entries.opportunity: Multishot audio/video and staged fidelity rendering; distilled baseline then refinement.
entries.caveat: New Gemma4 encoder and split dependencies. Fixed distilled schedule; CUDA paths do not establish AMD support.

entries.title: Wan2.2 I2V A14B
entries.opportunity: Independent image-to-video comparison lane, retaining its noise-stage model pair.
entries.caveat: Pair matching high/low-noise components; do not label every VACE workflow Wan2.2.

entries.title: VACE official editing pipeline
entries.opportunity: Reference/video/masked-video editing; start with an explicitly supported Wan2.1-VACE recipe.
entries.caveat: Original supported releases include Wan2.1 and older LTX; community Wan2.2 combinations need separate proof.

entries.title: WanVideoWrapper
entries.opportunity: Rich example workflows for experimental control, portrait motion and model extensions.
entries.caveat: Author prefers native ComfyUI where equivalent functionality exists; wrapper graphs are not interchangeable.

entries.title: VideoHelperSuite
entries.opportunity: Frame selection, batched media I/O and video assembly around model stages.
entries.caveat: Retain timestamps, fps, audio and color assumptions in the run manifest.

entries.title: SeedVR2 video upscaler
entries.opportunity: Independent restoration branch to compare with model-native latent refinement.
entries.caveat: Keep temporal windows consistent; test whether fine details flicker or are invented.

entries.title: TRELLIS.2
entries.opportunity: Image-to-3D and PBR asset candidate for an isolated compatible worker.
entries.caveat: Official path targets Linux and NVIDIA with at least 24GB VRAM; not a drop-in Windows Radeon recipe.

entries.title: Hunyuan3D 2.1
entries.opportunity: Compare staged geometry and texturing rather than only attractive turntables.
entries.caveat: Check geometry and texture environments separately; generated meshes still need topology and material review.

entries.title: TripoSG
entries.opportunity: Independent shape reconstruction candidate for a small object benchmark.
entries.caveat: Audit compiled dependencies and exact local resource requirements before installation.

entries.title: UniRig
entries.opportunity: Skeleton and skinning proposal for approved character meshes.
entries.caveat: Evaluate extreme-pose deformation, attachments and engine round-trip; not production rig certification.

entries.title: Material Maker
entries.opportunity: Procedural tileable materials and controllable PBR complements to generated concepts.
entries.caveat: Retain procedural source; inferred roughness/normal maps are not measured material properties.

entries.title: AI Toolkit
entries.opportunity: Train a repeatable project identity or style after a baseline demonstrates the need.
entries.caveat: Dataset provenance, held-out views and family-specific AMD training feasibility are separate gates.

entries.title: Musubi Tuner
entries.opportunity: Model-specific video/image adapter training experiments.
entries.caveat: Supported training families and versions vary; isolate training from everyday inference.

entries.title: ACE-Step 1.5
entries.opportunity: Explore music as an optional independently versioned asset lane.
entries.caveat: Test loop boundaries, loudness and rights; do not silently add a hosted service.

entries.title: H3-World
entries.opportunity: Research direction: controlled, temporally coherent world generation.
entries.caveat: Paper-level discovery, not an audited runnable Studio integration.

entries.title: SolarWM
entries.opportunity: Research direction: long-horizon interactive generation.
entries.caveat: Inspect public code, weights and benchmarks before planning a local implementation.

entries.title: Code World Model
entries.opportunity: Research direction: explicit scene state and proxy rendering driving visual generation.
entries.caveat: Keep authoritative game state in code; generated imagery must not become the simulation state.

entries.title: User-linked Civitai Seed Hunter
entries.opportunity: Intake target for an authenticated local metadata and graph export.
entries.caveat: Neither .red/.com page nor API returned inspectable workflow bytes in this research session.
